title: सम्बोधि कविता सङ्ग्रहमा प्रतिबिम्बित वैचारिक चेतना {Ideological Consciousness as Reflected in the Sambodhi Poetry Collection}
nepali: प्रस्तुत आलेखमा कवि नरेश शाक्यद्वारा लिखित सम्बोधि कविता सङ्ग्रहमा प्रतिबिम्बित वैचारिक चेतनाको रूपमा प्रगतिशील चेतनाको.विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । गुणात्मक ढाँचाको शोध अध्ययन र निगमनात्मक शोधपद्धति अँगालिएको यस आलेखमा मूलतः प्रगतिशील–प्रगतिवादी सैद्धान्तिक मान्यतालाई पर्याधार बनाइएको छ । सम्बोधि कविता सङ्ग्रहका कविताहरूमा केकस्ता प्रगतिशील र प्रगतिवादी चेतना प्रकट भएका छन्, सो वैचारिक विषयलाई शोधसमस्या र यही समस्याको अनुसन्धानात्मक एवं प्राज्ञिक खोज–अन्वेषण गरी निक्र्योलमा पुग्नुलाई शोधउद्देश्य बनाइएको छ । यसमा प्राथमिक र द्वितीयक सामग्रीको प्रयोग गरिएको छ ।यस आलेखमा सम्बोधि कविता सङ्ग्रहको वैचारिकतामा केन्द्रित भई अनुसन्धान कार्य सम्पन्न गरिएको छ ।यसमा कवि शाक्यको सम्बोधि कवितासङ्ग्रह मूलतः प्रगतिशील र अंशतः प्रगतिवादी चेतनामा केन्द्रित रहेको, यस कृतिले सामाजिक उन्नतिका निम्ति वैचारिक रूपमा मानव चेतनाको अग्रगामी स्वरलाई अभिव्यञ्जित गर्ने मुख्य लक्ष्य लिएको सारवस्तु प्राप्तिका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, the progressive consciousness as a form of the ideological consciousness reflected in the Sambodhi poetry collection written by poet Naresh Shakya has been analyzed. Adopting a qualitative research study and a deductive research method, this article has principally taken progressive–progressivist theoretical assumptions as its theoretical basis. What kinds of progressive and progressivist consciousness are manifested in the poems of the Sambodhi poetry collection — that ideological question has been made the research problem, and reaching a conclusion through investigative and academic inquiry into this very problem has been set as the research objective. Primary and secondary materials have been used in it. In this article, the research work has been completed focusing on the ideology of the Sambodhi poetry collection. In it, the Sambodhi poetry collection of poet Shakya is presented as essentially centered on progressive and partly on progressivist consciousness, with the substance obtained being that this work has taken as its main goal giving expression, in ideological terms, to the progressive voice of human consciousness for social progress.

informal_english: This article looks at the progressive consciousness running through the ideological consciousness reflected in Naresh Shakya's Sambodhi poetry collection. The study is qualitative and deductive, and it mainly leans on progressive–progressivist theory. The research problem is basically: what kinds of progressive and progressivist consciousness show up in the poems of the Sambodhi collection, and the goal is to dig into that question and reach a conclusion. It uses both primary and secondary material. The research zeroes in on the ideology of the Sambodhi collection. The takeaway is that Shakya's Sambodhi collection is mostly progressive and partly progressivist in its consciousness, and that the work's main aim is to give voice, in ideological terms, to the progressive voice of human consciousness for social progress.
